meta.model_1: L3 twin (8c) of today's calibration + the coherent waiting phase measured in 8d (12.8 / 22.3 kHz on Q36 / Q43, axis -z) in every idle window; L3+ adds random detunings, over-rotations and static ZZ
meta.anchored: 8d hardware value + [twin(today) - twin(4-Oct calibration of 8d Round 1)] for the blocks 8d measured; for the 4 / 16 us waits: model 2 + the same twin shift
meta.model_2: Pauli-twirl model: diag(R T) of each leg from the REAL 4-Oct TOMO-9 T matrices; the wait moved to 4 / 16 us with a linear phase (wait-only slope of 9.8) and today's T1 / T2 records; leg q2's extra coherence loss quasi-static (main) or Markovian
success_criteria: REPLICATION (both states): F(N1 + fresh TOMO-9, K2) >= F(native) - 2 sigma; recovered fraction (F_corr - F_none) / (F_native - F_none) >= 0.9 (as 8d)
STORED CORRECTION: |F(N1 + stored 4-Oct correction) - F(N1 + fresh TOMO-9)| <= 0.02 (expected if the device's own rotations did not drift much); a larger gap measures that drift
WAIT PHASE: the TOMO-9 rotation angle of the wait is linear in tau (fit theta = a + b tau, chi^2 p > 0.001)
WAIT COHERENCE (leg q2): the 16 us / 8 us x-y factor decides between quasi-static and Markovian (likelihood ratio of the two pre-computed values)
WAIT CORRECTION: F(N2 + TOMO-9) - F(N2 none) > 3 sigma at every tau
